description.p: Convertoor converts almost any file to almost any other format. Drop in images, audio, video, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, ebooks, archives, fonts or data files, pick a format and press Convert.
It drives proven open-source tools — FFmpeg, ImageMagick, Pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, librsvg, libheif, Calibre and fontTools — and automatically chains them when no single tool can do the job.
